capabilities: Browse snapshots and git commits on a single chronological timeline
Compare versions with colored cumulative or step-by-step diffs
Restore a full version or selected changes only
Force-create File Recovery snapshots on demand
Export or freeze a note's history as Markdown
disambiguation: Not a whole-vault backup tool; it browses and restores per-note history from snapshots and git commits.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; git features are desktop-only. A one-time dialog after updates shows release notes with support links. Full documentation lives on external usage/configuration pages.
intentEvidence: Time Machine turns Obsidian's built-in File Recovery snapshots and git commits into a visual version rail
problem: Obsidian's File Recovery core plugin saves snapshots but offers only a basic restore UI, and git history is invisible inside the app.
summary: Version history browser that shows File Recovery snapshots and git commits as a timeline with diffs, selective restore, and history export.
